sample_unit: data segments (from 952 documents across 162 Reddit threads)

links.outcome: Clinician-reported AI scribe note problems such as misattribution, hallucinations, omissions
links.effect: Clinicians reported content problems including misattribution, hallucinations and omissions, plus workflow disruptions such as latency, crashes and copy-and-paste friction. No frequency rates given.
links.quote: Reported problems included content-related issues, such as misattribution, hallucinations and omissions, as well as workflow disruptions, including latency, crashes and copy-and-paste friction.

links.outcome: Whether clinician verification identifies and corrects AI scribe errors before they propagate
links.effect: Documentation problems arose through socio-technical interactions that influence whether errors are identified, corrected or carried forward. Risk depended on integration quality, governance clarity and review capacity.
links.quote: The findings suggest that documentation problems may arise through socio-technical interactions that influence whether errors are identified, corrected or carried forward.

screen.reason: This is an empirical netnographic qualitative study examining real-world clinician experiences, failures, and risks with ambient AI scribes in clinical practice across socio-technical dimensions.
